verdict.rationale: Startup financing advice is a fair question for a full-service law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents private equity, fund structuring (including venture capital funds), M&A and ESOP tax analysis, but nothing on SAFEs, convertible notes or CCDs, pre-seed or seed rounds, or a stated early-stage financing practice. Fund-formation and PE expertise is adjacent and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice
